title: Oven Roasted Dutch Vegetable Stew
description: A hearty and flavorful one-pot dish featuring a medley of vegetables in a rich cranberry juice broth, cooked to perfection in a Dutch oven. This ayurvedic-sattvic-friendly recipe is perfect for a comforting dinner.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 425 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large Dutch oven, heat the olive oil over medium heat.
Add the chopped carrots, Brussels sprouts, and red potatoes to the pot, stirring to combine.
Pour in the cranberry juice, and sprinkle the salt, black pepper, and chopped thyme over the top.
Cover the pot with a lid, and transfer it to the preheated oven.
Roast the stew for 30 minutes, then remove the lid and continue roasting for an additional 20 minutes, or until the vegetables are tender and lightly browned.
Remove the pot from the oven, and let it cool slightly before serving.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with additional fresh thyme if desired.
